Stay updated on data science education events, workshops, and conferences.

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis

import yaml
import json
from datetime import datetime, date, timedelta
from pathlib import Path
from IPython.display import display, Markdown

# Load events data
events_file = Path("../_data/events.yml")
with open(events_file, "r") as f:
    data = yaml.safe_load(f)

events = data.get("events", [])

# Category colors (WCAG AA contrast with white text)
category_colors = {
    "conference": "#1a365d",
    "workshop": "#1e6f30",
    "webinar": "#553c9a",
    "meeting": "#8b4513",
    "hackathon": "#9b2c2c",
    "other": "#4a5568"
}

category_labels = {
    "conference": "Conference",
    "workshop": "Workshop",
    "webinar": "Webinar",
    "meeting": "Meeting",
    "hackathon": "Hackathon",
    "other": "Other"
}

# Convert events to FullCalendar format
fc_events = []
for event in events:
    color = category_colors.get(event.get("category", "other"), category_colors["other"])

    fc_event = {
        "title": event["title"],
        "start": event["date"],
        "backgroundColor": color,
        "borderColor": color,
        "textColor": "#ffffff",
        "extendedProps": {
            "description": event.get("description", ""),
            "location": event.get("location", "TBD"),
            "time": event.get("time", "TBD"),
            "category": event.get("category", "other"),
            "link": event.get("link", "")
        }
    }

    # Handle end date (FullCalendar end is exclusive, so add 1 day)
    if event.get("end_date"):
        end_date = datetime.strptime(event["end_date"], "%Y-%m-%d").date()
        end_date += timedelta(days=1)
        fc_event["end"] = end_date.strftime("%Y-%m-%d")

    # Add link as URL so right-click works
    if event.get("link"):
        fc_event["url"] = event["link"]

    fc_events.append(fc_event)

events_json = json.dumps(fc_events)

# Build the legend HTML
legend_html = '<div class="calendar-legend">'
for cat, color in category_colors.items():
    label = category_labels.get(cat, cat.title())
    legend_html += f'<span class="legend-item"><span class="legend-color" style="background-color: {color};"></span>{label}</span>'
legend_html += '</div>'

# Output the calendar HTML and JavaScript
html_output = f'''
{legend_html}

<div id="calendar"></div>

<div id="tooltip-overlay" style="display: none;"></div>

<div id="event-tooltip" class="event-tooltip" style="display: none;">
  <button class="tooltip-close" onclick="closeTooltip()">&times;</button>
  <h4 id="tooltip-title"></h4>
  <div class="tooltip-meta">
    <p><strong>Date:</strong> <span id="tooltip-date"></span></p>
    <p><strong>Time:</strong> <span id="tooltip-time"></span></p>
    <p><strong>Location:</strong> <span id="tooltip-location"></span></p>
  </div>
  <p id="tooltip-description"></p>
  <a id="tooltip-link" href="#" class="tooltip-link" style="display: none;">Learn more →</a>
</div>

<script>
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {{
  var calendarEl = document.getElementById('calendar');
  var tooltip = document.getElementById('event-tooltip');
  var overlay = document.getElementById('tooltip-overlay');

  var calendar = new FullCalendar.Calendar(calendarEl, {{
    initialView: 'dayGridMonth',
    height: 'auto',
    headerToolbar: {{
      left: 'prev,next today',
      center: 'title',
      right: 'dayGridMonth,listMonth'
    }},
    buttonText: {{
      today: 'Today',
      month: 'Grid',
      list: 'List'
    }},
    events: {events_json},
    eventClick: function(info) {{
      // Prevent navigation to URL
      info.jsEvent.preventDefault();
      info.jsEvent.stopPropagation();

      var event = info.event;
      var props = event.extendedProps;

      // Format date
      var startDate = event.start;
      var endDate = event.end;
      var dateStr = startDate.toLocaleDateString('en-US', {{
        weekday: 'long',
        year: 'numeric',
        month: 'long',
        day: 'numeric'
      }});

      if (endDate) {{
        // Subtract 1 day since FullCalendar end is exclusive
        var actualEnd = new Date(endDate);
        actualEnd.setDate(actualEnd.getDate() - 1);
        if (actualEnd > startDate) {{
          dateStr += ' - ' + actualEnd.toLocaleDateString('en-US', {{
            weekday: 'long',
            year: 'numeric',
            month: 'long',
            day: 'numeric'
          }});
        }}
      }}

      document.getElementById('tooltip-title').textContent = event.title;
      document.getElementById('tooltip-title').style.color = event.backgroundColor;
      document.getElementById('tooltip-date').textContent = dateStr;
      document.getElementById('tooltip-time').textContent = props.time || 'TBD';
      document.getElementById('tooltip-location').textContent = props.location || 'TBD';
      document.getElementById('tooltip-description').textContent = props.description || '';

      var linkEl = document.getElementById('tooltip-link');
      if (props.link) {{
        linkEl.href = props.link;
        linkEl.target = '_blank';
        linkEl.style.display = 'inline-block';
      }} else {{
        linkEl.style.display = 'none';
      }}

      tooltip.style.display = 'block';
      overlay.style.display = 'block';
      document.body.classList.add('tooltip-open');
    }}
  }});

  calendar.render();
}});

function closeTooltip() {{
  document.getElementById('event-tooltip').style.display = 'none';
  document.getElementById('tooltip-overlay').style.display = 'none';
  document.body.classList.remove('tooltip-open');
}}

// Close tooltip when clicking outside
document.addEventListener('click', function(e) {{
  var tooltip = document.getElementById('event-tooltip');
  if (!tooltip.contains(e.target) && !e.target.closest('.fc-event')) {{
    tooltip.style.display = 'none';
    document.getElementById('tooltip-overlay').style.display = 'none';
    document.body.classList.remove('tooltip-open');
  }}
}});

// Close on Escape key
document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {{
  if (e.key === 'Escape') {{
    closeTooltip();
  }}
}});

// Close when clicking the overlay
document.addEventListener('click', function(e) {{
  if (e.target.id === 'tooltip-overlay') {{
    closeTooltip();
  }}
}});
</script>

---

*Want to share information about an upcoming event? Contact us at [vivrd@berkeley.edu](mailto:vivrd@berkeley.edu).*
'''

display(Markdown(html_output))
```
